title: Meta Q4 2025 earnings beat expectations
content: Meta Platforms reported Q4 2025 revenue of $48.4 billion, up 21% year-over-year, driven by strong advertising demand and AI-powered feed improvements. Operating income reached $23.4 billion with a 48% operating margin.

title: Meta AI investments and capex guidance
content: Meta raised its 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $60-65 billion, primarily for AI infrastructure including data centers and custom silicon. CEO Mark Zuckerberg emphasized AI as the central investment theme.

title: Meta Reality Labs losses continue
content: Reality Labs segment reported an operating loss of $5.1 billion in Q4 2025, bringing full-year losses to $17.7 billion. The segment continues to invest in AR/VR hardware and software platforms.
